bio: This hip, cosmopolitan brasserie, Antwerp’s outpost of Bruge’s Bar Bulot, has found refuge in the lavish Botanic Sanctuary Hotel. Timeless classics such as asparagus à la flamande, vol-au-vent of Bresse chicken, sweetbread and shrimp are revamped to tempt and tickle today’s tastebuds. Top-notch ingredients and contemporary flavours, by way of exotic spices, add character to each dish. Heaven for discerning foodies!...
